# Nonlinear Transfer Ten-Phase Run

Date: 21 July 2026  
Stages: 41--50

## Programme decision

The run tests two routes from the dependent Gaussian dispersion window to a
nonlinear retained-state bound:

1. a normalized density/complement comparison on the certified local chart;
2. a gauge-covariant repair lifted from staple variables to lattice links.

It then extends the retained history and topology interfaces and recomputes
the multichannel budget.

## Hard stop

The continuous-channel number is a restricted centered-reference result. It
becomes physical only after normalized density and chart-complement estimates
hold uniformly over every finite volume and positive-mass retained history.
Center barriers, orbit coverage, and integer topology also require normalized
sector bounds. No one-scale basin, repeated RG, continuum construction, or
Hamiltonian mass gap is inferred.
